rules.classification: NEW spell-local finite-field completion using the named accepted casting/Ready interfaces
rules.text: These three spells alone use one Action, placement range120ft, V/S/F, actual rank9/base26RP and their exact native acquisition rows. Each creates a fixed, visible, nonphysical field with concentration for at most60 elapsed seconds from actual establishment, not preparation or commitment. Original Core Instantaneous metadata is retained as a conflict, not selected as the field lifetime. Field instances have stable owner, paid-cast and application IDs; precise establishment sequence, original deadline, current active/suppressed/ended state and no reset on movement, extra turns, saving/loading or reentry. A legal commitment pays its final affordable actual price, performs components, spends the Action and updates class/encounter history once before its one counter window. The incompatible previous concentration ends at that commitment before the final eligibility/price is evaluated; if this makes the final transaction unaffordable, do not commit the new cast or end the old source. Preflight calculates this post-transition quote without mutation. A committed countered/failed cast never restores the displaced source. Prospective concentration begins at commitment; the field is absent until successful establishment. Ordinary Ready pays at preparation, establishes only at surviving release, retains its real Reaction/trigger/target/next-regular-START and any earlier source deadline, and never pays or updates casting history again. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 applies only where its seven actual copied-feat profiles independently allow that source; it grants no rank9 payload permission or extra Action. These fields do not grant concentration slots. A source-qualified Tether remains separately acquired/paid and uses its own duration; no fixture silently activates it. At expiry or actual concentration loss, actual eligible dispel/removal, actual creator death, or loss of the authoritative same-plane field anchor, end this field once. Voluntary concentration release follows the ordinary rule. Planar separation of the creator alone does not move or automatically delete the anchored field; inability to maintain concentration follows its actual source. No field grants support, cover, heat, solid collision, magical components, loot or a hidden object to harvest.

Furnace and Supreme Nexus are radius30ft spheres; Singularity is a radius10ft sphere around its specified point. Choose a perceived same-plane point within120ft of the actual permitted casting origin and actual line of effect. The fixed anchor may be in air; no floor or support is required because this is not a body. Actual solid total cover clips each field radially from its center. A body qualifies if its interior has a nonempty intersection with the operative volume; boundary-only tangency does not qualify. Point anchors and source origins use closed distance<=radius with a genuinely unblocked center-to-point path; a point hidden inside solid terrain or a closed opaque object that prevents the required placement line is illegal. Because these fields have no body, an unoccupied center is not required: the caster may use its own actual casting origin, and a perceived creature's occupied space is not automatically an illegal solid-terrain center. This supplies no view through an opaque barrier or concealed interior. Use actual current bodies, not five-foot centers alone, and preserve source-required paths and target restrictions. No straight-line projectile is invented for a nonprojectile spell, teleport, thought or area. Ordinary field entry/exit creates no Action, attack, RNG, reveal, price recomputation or release. The created fields remain visibly identifiable as a damage-support forge-pattern, absorbing point, or enhancement lattice, but have no magical detection benefit. No later movement of a creator recenters them.

rules.classification: NEW finite ordering only for interactions involving these fields
rules.text: Use the actual scheduler timestamp and authoritative event sequence, not player descriptions. Source deadlines/ordinary required teardown win at equality. Then complete the legally due parent trigger and declared cast/Ready checkpoint, source-specific concentration transition, final price/atomic payment/history and existing LIFO counter windows. Surviving effect resolution queries actual operative fields: first actual source prohibitions and Lesser Antimagic suppression, then Singularity absorption, then surviving enhancement/attack-save/damage/healing/condition operations and ordinary consequences. Do not draw an absorbed target's attack/save or effect dice; one area shared pool is still drawn once if any unabsorbed recipient requires it. Complete source-qualified on-resolution refunds before settling that source's pending conversion entitlement. A committed reaction remains governed by its real trigger; fields grant none. Same-time creations are sequenced by authoritative creation sequence then stable application ID. Only already-established eligible Singularity instances may intercept a new field's formation before insertion. A field is never its own input. Between already-existing fields use the same oldest eligible absorber then application-ID rule, marking a local consumption receipt before removal callbacks. Removed absorbers do no later work in the queue. Each local manifestation and each source-use conversion receipt can transition once; teardown, conversion credits, pricing discounts and informational cues are terminal bookkeeping, not new absorbable spell casts or recursively amplifiable magical payloads. A committed source-derived recurring pulse is an output, not a fresh price or conversion-origin identity unless its actual source expressly creates a separately paid activation. This is a local dispatch integration requirement, not a proof that a game scheduler implements it.

rules.classification: NEW Supreme-only insertion; preserves accepted AC5/AC6 bucket order outside this insertion
rules.text: Validate source entitlement and actual body at the real payment checkpoint. Start creditableBase B after actual source/class base-only reductions, waivers and their own minima; E is genuinely discountable ordinary extras including applicable strain/optional RP extras. Keep named protected principal P separate: Barrier X, Forge cycle5, actual Conduit/Transfusion transfer value and any other source that expressly protects its principal. HP, materials, charges, uses, RC and non-RP currencies are not B or E. Source ownership and rank never change with price. For an actual spell, apply one operative ordinary Nexus -2 to B first, then E. For a qualifying Supreme activation, let T=B+E and savings=ceil(T/2); subtract savings from B first and then E, yielding floor(T/2). Thus half of an odd combined price is computed once, not separately per bucket. This explicit allocation controls actually-paid-base attribution. Add accepted spell-only Dampening +2 afterward; then apply one real pending final Influence: Ease subtracts base first, then E, then Dampening, floor0; Burden is noncreditable. Finally add protected P in full. There is no new Supreme minimum: a1RP discountable amount becomes0. Existing source minima govern their own preceding calculation; an exact source prohibition on reduction still governs its protected amount. Neither ordinary Nexus nor Dampening/Influence becomes a nonspell rule. Supreme expressly also halves a genuinely magical nonspell activation's actual ordinary RP fee at its own commitment, after that source's reductions, but not protected transfers/principal; it neither supplies a missing RP pool nor invents an RP price for a charge-only or RC source. An independently defined recurring magical service fee can qualify at each real new payment; ongoing concentration itself is not a payment. Pending rank9 Perfect Spell/Perfection/Ascendance and other unselected cost replacements are not rules here. Barrier/other actual-paid-base outputs use the retained B, never a nominal full base or saved RP. Exact eligible base refunds see this same actual B, only at their actual triggers and frequency. No discount is a recovery credit.

rules.classification: NEW multiplier stage only; inherited source damage/life/Null order remains
rules.text: For surviving eligible damage, preserve the complete source's hit/save sequence, native dice and real source-specific class/rider stages. Criticals double only actually eligible dice before this amplification. At the ordinary pre-save raw-damage stage combine the eligible Furnace3/2 and Supreme5/4 rational multipliers and floor once on the combined nonnegative typed packet, not once per source. Allocate that total proportionally to the original nonnegative typed parts: floor each exact share, then distribute the remaining points by descending fractional remainder, stable normalized damage-type name and original component ordinal. One multiplier application does not create another hit/root/Wound check. Then use the source's stated per-type save-success rule and actual typed defenses, reduction order, pure prevention, sharing, tempHP, life and Wound rules. Source-specific later-stage bonuses such as Elemental Supremacy remain at their printed later stage and do not return through amplification. Separate hits and actual later pulses get their own permitted query; pure reflected/transferred descendants retain their already-scaled original packet and flags without re-amplification or new conversion funding. Preserve source prohibitions on external amplification, copied-feat payload budgets, recovery funding, intrinsic class engines and relic properties. The actual original damage dealer—not a field supporter—is recorded on each source-authorized root. A true creation-time Null flag remains unchanged on all descendants; later field eligibility does not resnapshot it. A separately created later root follows its exact accepted source. Absorption is not damage, cannot create a Wound, damage-based recovery or kill credit, and creates no fictitious prevented-damage root.

rules.classification: NEW receipt obligations; no runtime persistence claim
rules.text: Authoritative field, cast, paid-base, refund, continuous-source, child-manifestation, conversion, pending-credit and effect-lifecycle IDs survive reloads. A pending receipt must resume its one recorded transaction, not recompute from a client preview or current nominal rank price. RNG faces are consumed only by the actual underlying outcome; a failed validation, duplicate callback or absorbed output cannot consume another draw. Current observers see permitted audiovisual cues and their own actual pool/result changes only. Private source IDs, hidden casters, invisible inventories, protected motives, local false-target classification and absorbed-category records remain private. Previewing a price cannot activate absorption, spend Influence, consume RNG, leak a roster or supply a sixth DE4 presentation. Unknown source qualification is resolved using ordinary authoritative hidden data without a new diagnostic. Expected field benefits do not grant repertoire, attunement, recipes, knowledge, resources, extra phases, real-time/turn-mode policy or cosmology. The original all-magic promise is fulfilled through the category map, not a damage-only whitelist; a genuinely undefined external magical source needs its own native adapter without disabling these complete ordinary positive procedures.
